verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֣חַ בִּ֭נְגִינוֹת עַֽל־ הַשְּׁמִינִ֗ית מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃ יְֽהוָ֗ה אַל־ בְּאַפְּךָ֥ תוֹכִיחֵ֑נִי וְֽאַל־ בַּחֲמָתְךָ֥ תְיַסְּרֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ bin·ḡî·nō·wṯ ‘al- haš·šə·mî·nîṯ miz·mō·wr lə·ḏā·wiḏ Yah·weh ’al- bə·’ap·pə·ḵā ṯō·w·ḵî·ḥê·nî wə·’al- ba·ḥă·mā·ṯə·ḵā ṯə·yas·sə·rê·nî
verses.literal: For the choirmaster With stringed instruments according to Sheminith A Psalm of David O LORD do not rebuke me in Your anger or discipline me in Your wrath

verses.original: חָנֵּ֥נִי יְהוָה֮ כִּ֤י אֻמְלַ֫ל אָ֥נִי רְפָאֵ֥נִי יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֖י נִבְהֲל֣וּ עֲצָמָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ḥān·nê·nî Yah·weh kî ’um·lal ’ā·nî rə·p̄ā·’ê·nî Yah·weh kî niḇ·hă·lū ‘ă·ṣā·māy
verses.literal: Be merciful to me O LORD for I am frail heal me O LORD for my bones are in agony

verses.original: וְ֭נַפְשִׁי נִבְהֲלָ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד וְאַתְּ יְ֝הוָ֗ה עַד־ מָתָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nap̄·šî niḇ·hă·lāh mə·’ōḏ wə·ʾat Yah·weh ‘aḏ- mā·ṯāy
verses.literal: My soul is deeply distressed . . . How long O LORD how long

verses.original: שׁוּבָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה חַלְּצָ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֑י ה֝וֹשִׁיעֵ֗נִי לְמַ֣עַן חַסְדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: šū·ḇāh Yah·weh ḥal·lə·ṣāh nap̄·šî hō·wō·šî·‘ê·nî lə·ma·‘an ḥas·de·ḵā
verses.literal: Turn O LORD and deliver my soul save me because of Your loving devotion

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֵ֣ין בַּמָּ֣וֶת זִכְרֶ֑ךָ בִּ֝שְׁא֗וֹל מִ֣י יֽוֹדֶה־ לָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’ên bam·mā·weṯ ziḵ·re·ḵā biš·’ō·wl mî yō·w·ḏeh- lāḵ
verses.literal: For there is no mention of You in death who can praise You from Sheol

verses.original: יָגַ֤עְתִּי׀ בְּֽאַנְחָתִ֗י אַשְׂחֶ֣ה בְכָל־ לַ֭יְלָה מִטָּתִ֑י בְּ֝דִמְעָתִ֗י עַרְשִׂ֥י אַמְסֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: yā·ḡa‘·tî bə·’an·ḥā·ṯî ’aś·ḥeh ḇə·ḵāl- lay·lāh miṭ·ṭā·ṯî bə·ḏim·‘ā·ṯî ‘ar·śî ’am·seh
verses.literal: I am weary from groaning all night I flood my bed with weeping and drench my couch with tears

verses.original: עָֽשְׁשָׁ֣ה מִכַּ֣עַס עֵינִ֑י עָֽ֝תְקָ֗ה בְּכָל־ צוֹרְרָֽי׃
verses.literal: My eyes fail from grief they grow dim because of all my foes

verses.original: ס֣וּרוּ מִ֭מֶּנִּי כָּל־ פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן כִּֽי־ שָׁמַ֥ע יְ֝הוָ֗ה ק֣וֹל בִּכְיִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: sū·rū mim·men·nî kāl- pō·‘ă·lê ’ā·wen kî- šā·ma‘ Yah·weh qō·wl biḵ·yî
verses.literal: Depart from me all you workers of iniquity for the LORD has heard my weeping

verses.original: שָׁמַ֣ע יְ֭הוָה תְּחִנָּתִ֑י יְ֝הוָ֗ה תְּֽפִלָּתִ֥י יִקָּֽח׃
verses.transliteration: šā·ma‘ Yah·weh tə·ḥin·nā·ṯî Yah·weh tə·p̄il·lā·ṯî yiq·qāḥ
verses.literal: The LORD has heard my cry for mercy the LORD accepts my prayer

verses.original: יֵבֹ֤שׁוּ׀ וְיִבָּהֲל֣וּ מְ֭אֹד כָּל־ אֹיְבָ֑י יָ֝שֻׁ֗בוּ יֵבֹ֥שׁוּ רָֽגַע׃
verses.transliteration: yê·ḇō·šū wə·yib·bā·hă·lū mə·’ōḏ kāl- ’ō·yə·ḇāy yā·šu·ḇū yê·ḇō·šū rā·ḡa‘
verses.literal: All my enemies will be ashamed and dismayed . . . they will turn back in sudden disgrace
